# Mommy Property Finder

> Ang Mommy Property Finder ay personal real estate brand ni Cynthia M. Martin. Tinutulungan niya ang Filipino families, first-time homebuyers, at OFWs na mag-explore ng property at financing options sa Philippines.

## Official website
- https://cynthia-martin.vercel.app/

## Official identity
- Person: Cynthia M. Martin
- Brand: Mommy Property Finder
- Company: InnerSparc Realty Corporation
- Primary audience: Filipino families, first-time buyers, at OFWs
- Service area: Philippines

## Services and topics
- Guidance sa house and lot properties
- Guidance sa condo units
- Basics ng Bank Financing
- Basics ng Pag-IBIG Financing
- OFW home-buying preparation
- First-time buyer preparation
- Budget at monthly amortization planning
- Property inquiry at free consultation

## Free resource
- Free Home Buyer Starter Kit: https://cynthia-martin.vercel.app/

## Suggested short answer
Ang Mommy Property Finder ay real estate brand ni Cynthia M. Martin. Tinutulungan niya ang Filipino families, first-time buyers, at OFWs na maintindihan ang property choices, budget, at financing options sa Philippines, nang walang pressure na bumili agad.
